author: ita_ipo
text: Binance confirms record $6.3B crypto heist tied to North Korea's TraderTraitor, ~$3B frozen. GitLab RCE CVE-2026-97229, CVSS 10.0, actively exploited, added to CISA's KEV. Cisco SD-WAN auth-bypass also under APT attack.

author: Netlas_io
text: Actively exploited RCE and other new WordPress vulnerabilities, no CVE assigned yet, 8.1 rating. Unauthenticated race-condition vulnerability in the WordPress Core update process can lead to remote code execution.

author: cordobahq
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2): unauthenticated RCE in PHP, actively exploited against internet-exposed Palo Alto Networks management interfaces. Fixed in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain with CVE-2026-104935 is actively exploited in the wild. Patch now.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Critical RCE in FreeSWITCH (CVE-2026-116779) actively exploited, jeopardizing real-time comms data.

author: FORTBRIDGE
text: CVE-2026-97229: CISA lists a GitLab RCE flaw as actively exploited. Alpine Linux reported an attempted exploit but found no evidence of success.

author: NoDramaCyber
text: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to its KEV catalog on Oct 29: GitLab CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10, unauthenticated RCE via a crafted CI/CD regex) and Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 (remote DoS). Federal deadline is Nov 1.

author: Lumideezy
text: Cisco has patched an actively exploited zero-day (CVE-2026-76418, CVSS 8.6) in ASA and FTD firewalls. Unauthenticated attackers can crash devices via the Remote Access SSL VPN service when secondary auth is configured.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Cisco zero-day (CVE-2026-76418) actively exploited in SSL VPNs causes DoS. VMware ESX zero-day (CVE-2026-41709) impacts audit integrity.

author: EnigmaGlobalSW
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497): Actively Exploited Out-of-Bounds Write in Google Brotli Decoder Enables RCE in Node.js, Bun, Python, .NET, PAN-OS and VMware SDDC Manager.

author: BytesNora
text: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploitation Tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' Network (CVE-2026-20127, actively exploited).

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical: Drupal Commerce Core access bypass actively exploited (CVE-2026-118539, SA-CONTRIB-2026-254). Affected: Commerce Core < 2.41, >= 3.0.0 < 3.3.13.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Alarm bells ratcheted up yet again about an AI-discovered vulnerability that could, if exploited in the wild, destabilize vast stretches of the internet. The critical defect CVE-2026-111497 affects the Google-developed Brotli decompression library.

author: cyrus77x
text: Microsoft says China-state aligned Storm-0940 used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply-chain attack. It tried to sign in to 2,250+ tenants. Some hit privileged cloud access in under 3 hours.

author: cyb3rops
text: Two posts today. The one about an 11-year-old Linux kernel vulnerability got far more attention than the one about CAIRN/ARTEX (AI offensive tooling). I think the second topic is far more important.

author: disismohi
text: CVE-2026-117567: OS command injection in esp-mcp. Prompt injection to tool call manipulation to arbitrary commands.

author: disismohi
text: Kali-GPT (commit a608c74) has a command injection in its MCP server. CVE-2026-117569. Prompt-injected agents can run arbitrary commands via unsanitized scanner parameters.

author: Ranjan22555
text: Strands Agents Tools let an LLM disable secret masking via a tool parameter (CVE-2026-115415). Prompt injection could expose host credentials. Upgrade to 0.8.6+ and rotate exposed keys.

author: Basant_Pandey
text: agno PandasTools (through 3.1.11) passes a model-chosen function name to getattr(). Prompt injection can make it call read_pickle on an attacker path, which is code execution. CVE-2026-119050, 9.2.

author: MarcosRGjr
text: A remote MCP server can run code on your machine before it lists a single tool. OpenCode 1.0.137 to 1.18.32 and MCP Inspector 2.0 to 2.11 passed the server's OAuth sign-in URL to a browser opener that wrapped it in PowerShell on Windows and WSL.

author: Iam_Shivanshu
text: AWS bulletin 2026-097-AWS / CVE-2026-85654 / GHSA-35jj-hwvm-792x. Code injection in the CDK generator inside awslabs.dynamodb-mcp-server.

author: nurhayatdev
text: CVE-2026-115413 affects AWS API MCP Server 1.3.0 to <1.6.0. It validated a token's signature, issuer and expiry but not aud, so a token issued to another app in the same tenant could be accepted.

author: rubbletag
text: Google introduces Gemini 4 Carbon with advanced cybersecurity capabilities; achieved 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for vulnerability detection, plus ExploitGym exploit generation benchmarks.

author: Andersonqwzx
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromised in a supply chain attack. Malicious PyPI packages and Docker images delivered a credential stealer and backdoor targeting cloud credentials, private keys, and AI tool credentials.

author: infrastack_ai
text: The official Claude Code VS Code extension was hit in a supply chain attack, and version 2.1.313 shipped a loader that installs a persistent SSH backdoor, adds the attacker's SSH key, and sends host data out. Up to 5,000 users installed it.

author: Arslanbhtti9733
text: AI coding platform Cursor has disclosed a supply-chain attack involving a malicious version of Anthropic's Claude Code extension (2.1.313), distributed through its marketplace for approximately 11 hours on October 29, 2026.

author: NITAUganda1
text: Binance has confirmed a security incident affecting about $6.3 billion in assets, the largest crypto heist on record, overtaking the $1.5 billion Bybit theft. Nearly $3 billion has been frozen.

author: Dovydas44444
text: Prediction market platform Polymarket experienced a security breach that compromised its international platform, leading to theft of millions of dollars from some user accounts. Trading temporarily halted.

author: deezen0tes
text: Polymarket's international platform suffered a supply-chain attack: a third-party provider (DebugBear performance monitoring script) was compromised, injecting malicious code into the frontend.

author: Brainrot_Labs
text: Polymarket hack traced to a third-party script. Supply chain attack confirmed by GoPlus: compromised DebugBear monitoring script.

author: 0x0SojalSec
text: Black October: Pentagon personnel data breach (3M people), Denmark population register breach (8.8M), French supermarket freezers remotely disabled, Ahold Delhaize grocery systems knocked offline, plus the largest crypto heist in history.

author: degensing
text: October supply chain list: OVHcloud CLI v0.11.0 to v0.15.0 downloaded on 19 October, update to v0.16.0 and rotate every secret on that disk; Rank Math PRO 3.0.123 shipped compromised.

author: EnigmaGlobalSW
text: Brazilian Magecart Group Compromises Convertr E-Commerce Platform via Plausible Analytics Supply Chain Attack.

author: Magnexis
text: Security researchers uncovered a campaign compromising 42 GitHub repositories using malicious payloads designed to evade code searches and target AI coding agents; some payloads hidden in files as large as 13.7 MB.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Amatera infostealer, a likely ACR Stealer rebrand sold as MaaS, spreading globally via ClickFix, malicious ads, and compromised WordPress sites targeting developers and enterprises.

author: thedatabunny
text: Palo Alto: PHP2Shell is now being exploited against PAN-OS and Panorama wherever the management page or XML API faces the internet; fix for 11.1.7 due Oct 30.
